sources: dossier=Required behaviors bullet 2 ('undeclared tag on an outcome -> executor_protocol_violation', 2026-06-17 b31002b8, transcript) plus the 2026-06-24 ephemeral-tags entry (tags never persist into node state, which is a narrower claim than blanket inertness); doc=line 11 'inert to rimsky (they affect no node state)' and line 27 'Tags are inert; rimsky reads them only at cascade-walk CEL evaluation ... and at signal persistence'; code=validateTags (runner_dispatch.go:342-353) converts a would-be success/park/error into a executor_protocol_violation error terminal on any undeclared tag, a third state-affecting read site the doc's enumeration omitted
